checks.name: all three migrations apply and new migration can be replayed
legacy snapshot and old mutations retain social and fractional fire timestamps
RPCs and resolver are denied to clients, RLS still restricts outsiders
nonvisitors, missing requests, unknown actions and resources are rejected
concurrent resource claims permit exactly one owner
one actor has one resource and releases only their own seat
same request is idempotent and cannot be reused by another actor
stale occupied seats expire on read without changing stored state or version
barbecue validates food and slot and rejects simultaneous slot use
barbecue requires 30 seconds and a flip, shared serve and eat are atomic
eating expires at four seconds without an UPDATE
overdone food remains edible and serving table is capped at twelve
circle host recruitment releases a seat and prevents duplicate events
start requires host and at least four participants
recruiting supports eight maximum and releases participant resources
start resets all old recruitment leases and schedules 5s countdown plus 60s run
countdown and run time boundaries resolve identically without writing
fifteen-second lease expiry prunes participants and transfers host
losing one of four leases at exactly fifteen seconds ends the event
circle heartbeat rejects outsiders and renews only the actor lease
leaving below four ends the event and finished phase cannot resurrect
recruitment expires at two minutes even while visitors remain live
fire stop finishes a circle and restarting fire cannot revive it
recruiting host transfer and empty recruitment cleanup
an active circle remains finished after fire stop and restart
repeated snapshots and legacy read do not change campground version
